title: Current NFL depth charts replace empty key-player context
items: NFL fixtures now ingest nflverse's current 2026 depth charts and weekly rosters from GitHub, refreshed daily and cached so hourly builds do not repeatedly download the bulk release.
Expanded pregame context shows named expected quarterbacks, skill players, and defensive starters for both teams, with the source observation time and any non-active roster status.
Every fixture identifies the depth chart as ESPN-derived and unconfirmed; it is not presented as a gameday inactive list or confirmed starting lineup.
The pipeline will not reuse the completed 2025 injury file as current 2026 information. Dedicated 2026 practice and injury reports remain missing until the new-season asset is published.

Normalized depth-chart context is retained in the durable pregame snapshot, while probability weight remains zero until prospective locked-pick evidence shows that a derived change signal improves forecasts.
